using namespace std;

long long row(long long m) {
    long long base = 6 * (m / 6);
    switch (m % 6) {
        case 5: return base + 4;
        case 4: return base + 2;
        default: return base;
    }
}

long long two(long long m) {
    if (m == 3) return 4;
    if (m == 7) return 12;
    return m < 3 ? 0 : 2 * m;
}

    if (m < n) {
        swap(n, m);
    }
    if (n == 1) return row(m);
    if (n == 2) return two(m);
    return 2 * (n * m / 2);
}
